subject: english
question:
Select the alternative from the given options that best expresses the same sentence in

active/passive voice.

How did you pay the bill?

options.text: How is the bill paid by you?
How the bill is to be paid by you?
How was the bill paid by you?
How the bill has been paid by you?

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "How did you pay the bill?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the bill" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "did pay" to "was paid" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "you."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"How was the bill paid by you?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"How is the bill paid by you?" – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"How the bill is to be paid by you?" – Incorrect structure (future passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"How the bill has been paid by you?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).

``
